newsitem.title: UK: Land Securities up on budget relief.
newsitem.headline: Land Securities up on budget relief.

text.p: Shares in British Land Plc and other top property stocks jumped sharply higher in pre-market trade on Thursday amid relief that yesterday's budget contained no severe measures against the sector.

Extending Wednesday's gains, Land Securities was up 15p at 886-1/2 by 0709 GMT, British Land Plc was up 9-1/2p at 593-1/2, Hammerson Plc was up 11-1/2p at 490, MEPC Plc was up 10p at 513-1/2 and Frogmore Estates Plc was up 4p at 571-1/2.
However, trading volume across the sector remained thin -- in Land Securities for instance it reached just 1,198 shares.

Some had speculated that Brown's budget could contain tax-rising measures against the property sector but Brown confined his targets to the housing sector and even there the measures were relatively modest.
"There were no nasty surprises" for the real estate industry, said one dealer.
